specification.group_rule: seen = company has any Old_fit (1999-2011) or New_fit (2012-2013) row; seen_new_fit = has a New_fit row; seen_old_fit_only = Old_fit rows only; 2014 DSEL/Calibration membership is recorded but does not define groups
specification.resampling: companies with replacement within (group, label) strata; all rows retained
specification.estimand: mean of ten seed-specific metrics within a company group
specification.intervals: pointwise percentile 95%; descriptive, no hypothesis tests or multiplicity claims
specification.scope: retrospective exploratory replay of saved predictions; no refit, no test-based selection
